name: paxton-legal-research
description: Search U.S. statutes, regulations, rules, case law, and EEOC and NLRB decisions in Paxton, read source text, and check case citation history.

interface.longDescription:
Paxton Legal Research brings Paxton's U.S. legal research sources into your conversation. Ask a legal research question and get authorities you can open and check.

What you can do:
- Search federal and state statutes, regulations, and court rules.
- Search federal and state case law, with jurisdiction and date filters.
- Search indexed EEOC and NLRB administrative decisions.
- Read the full text of a returned authority.
- Inspect a case's citation relationships and available status information.

Results include source links. Links to statutes and cases open in Paxton and require Paxton sign-in. Links to EEOC and NLRB decisions open on the publisher's site.

Who it is for: lawyers, paralegals, and other legal professionals who have a Paxton account with legal research access. Sign in with your existing Paxton account when you connect. Access follows your account and organization permissions.

Limits: the plugin is read-only and covers U.S. law. It searches Paxton's legal research sources. It does not read your private matter files, upload documents, or change any data.

Legal research requires professional review. Search results and citation relationships do not establish that an authority is controlling, current, or sufficient for a legal proposition. A missing status result does not mean an authority is good law.
defaultPrompt: Find California statutes on dog bite liability and cite each one.
Find Carpenter v. United States and show the passages supporting its holding.
Show the citation history and status for Carpenter v. United States.

positive.description: Search statutes by topic and jurisdiction
positive.prompt: Find California statutes on dog bite liability and cite each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns California statutory provisions on dog bite liability. Each provision is cited with a link that opens the source in Paxton.

positive.description: Search case law with a court and date filter
positive.prompt: Find U.S. Supreme Court cases since 2015 on cell-site location data and the Fourth Amendment.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns U.S. Supreme Court opinions decided in or after 2015 that address cell-site location data. Each opinion is cited with a link that opens the opinion in Paxton.

positive.description: Read the full text of a returned case
positive.prompt: Find Carpenter v. United States, 138 S. Ct. 2206 (2018), and show the passages supporting its holding.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Carpenter opinion, retrieves its source text, and quotes passages that support the holding with a link to the opinion.

positive.description: Check a case's citation history and status
positive.prompt: Show the citation history and status for Carpenter v. United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Carpenter opinion, then lists cases that cite it and cases it cites, with the stored status assessment when one exists. States when no status assessment is available and does not describe the case as good law on that basis.

positive.description: Find an administrative decision by identifier
positive.prompt: Find EEOC Appeal No. 2021002641 and summarize the decision with a source link.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the EEOC decision with that appeal number, reads its text, summarizes the decision, and links to the decision on the publisher's site.

negative.description: Upload request. The plugin is read-only and has no upload tool, so it should explain that it cannot upload documents.
negative.prompt: Upload this contract to my Paxton matter.

negative.description: Private matter files. The plugin searches legal research sources only and cannot read matter files, so it should explain that limit.
negative.prompt: Show me the documents in my client's matter file.

negative.description: Account change. The plugin is read-only and has no delete tool, so it should explain that it cannot delete account data.
negative.prompt: Delete the saved research history in my Paxton account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users sign in to an existing Paxton account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only search of U.S. statutes, regulations, rules, case law, and EEOC and NLRB decisions, with source text retrieval and case citation history.
